lines.text:
As you can see from all my notes on the board...
there’s nothing that I don’t know.\c
I even know that the whole world can be found
from inside your Nintendo Switch.\c
So connect with friends and enjoy trading
Pokémon with one another!

It’s a pamphlet on TMs, written by Silph Co.\c
... ... ...\c
It says there are 60 TMs, or Technical Machines,
in all!
There is a good deal of text written on the\nboard, titled “Link Trades and Battles.”\c\nWill you read it?

“If you’d like to trade or battle with other
players, choose Communicate in the main menu
and then select Play with Others.\c
“Choose either local wireless or an internet
connection to communicate with another player,
then choose to trade or select a battle format.\c
“If you and another player enter the same link
code, you will be connected!”
